items.title: AMD Rises 3% as CFO Lifts AI Chip Market Forecast Toward $3 Trillion; Intel Ticks Up
items.summary: AMD's CFO just reshaped how big the AI chip market could get, and investors sent the stock surging past a key technical level while quietly slamming a door on one of Intel's biggest hopes.

items.title: NVDA Stock Is Running. Is There Fuel Left?
items.summary: This chipmaker's stock has been on a historic tear, but for investors arriving now, the critical question is whether the business can still outrun its already premium price.

items.title: Why Qualcomm’s AI Chip Deal Proves Nvidia Is Still Top Dog
items.summary: Nvidia stock was slipping after Qualcomm's announcement of an AI infrastructure deal with Amazon.

items.title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: NVIDIA, Alphabet, AMD, Micron, Dell and Cisco
items.summary: NVIDIA, Alphabet and other AI leaders may have stronger foundations than the internet boom, backed by utilization, profits and valuations.

items.title: Apple, Jersey Mike’s, Casey’s, Meta, ServiceTitan, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Investors will be watching for whether Apple’s iPhone event on Wednesday serves as a catalyst for the broader market.  Apple  rose 0.3% with the tech giant expected to unveil a foldable iPhone, which will mark the device’s biggest design change since it debuted in 2007.  CEO John Ternus will host the event, his first since Tim Cook’s departure.

items.title: Prediction: NVIDIA Stock Has Returned 14,700% in 10 Years. Can It Do It Again?
items.summary: NVIDIA has minted fortunes once before, and its latest earnings suggest the AI hardware machine is still accelerating. But ballooning supply commitments, margin pressure, and a China-shaped hole in its revenue raise a real question about what the next decade actually looks like.

items.title: Cathie Wood Grows Robinhood Stake; Sheds More AMD, Palantir
items.summary: Cathie Wood's firm ARK Invest added to its already sizable position in the trading platform Robinhood, which is back in a buy zone.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures Fall As Oil Prices Push Stocks Toward Breaking Point; Apple iPhone Event Due
items.summary: Stocks fell Tuesday as oil prices and Treasury yields rose, but AMD and HPE led AI plays flashing buy signals. An Apple iPhone event is on tap.
